answer: Split-tally bond: one bond splits into halves summing to the posted total, blocking bulk fakes. One half goes by whisper to a tallier, sealed and never posted. A falcon courier carries it. The other half is a public signal. Talliers reconcile the halves; a mismatch or rented whisper burns both halves. Each fake pays 45 plus 70 locked; 1,000 fakes pay 115,000 for a 40,000 pool, a 75,000 loss. Honest agents file once, pay 45, keep bond and share.
